ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the resource: the quoted `version`, for example `"3"`.

expectedArrival.description: Omitted when the supplier gave none.

lineNo.description: 1-based; lines are numbered exactly 1..n in order.

sku.description: 1 to 64 characters without whitespace, control characters or `/`.

400.description:
Malformed JSON or an unknown field (`malformed-request`), a bad query
parameter (`invalid-query`), a missing `Idempotency-Key`
(`idempotency-key-required`), or a value that breaks a domain rule
(the `invalid-*`, `*-requires-*`, `duplicate-*`, `window-in-past` and
`invalid-condition` slugs).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: Malformed request
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: resource-creating requests must send a non-empty Idempotency-Key

value.title: SKU is invalid
value.detail: sku must be 1..64 characters without whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Window is invalid
value.detail: window must end after it starts and last at most 4 hours

404.description:
The resource in the path does not exist: `asn-not-found`,
`appointment-not-found` or `receipt-not-found`.
